initial_attempt.driver_issue: External smoke script read UTF-8 manifest with Windows default encoding; Antlercover lyric equality failed. Corrected driver to explicit UTF-8 and reran using the same new locked environment. No app/archive changes.

case_scope.AT-12: Review/ZIP component supports R23-R25: excluded private paths, bounded credential scan, all four audio files accounted for by retained class-sample provenance. No new browser/runtime-upload/privacy acceptance.

reproduction: Fetch GitHub main and fast-forward the unused local main reference; candidate must be an ancestor of local main for the existing gate.
Download archive_url anonymously with curl --fail --location; compare archive_sha256 and archive_bytes.

At the candidate checkout: python scripts/check_readiness.py --template <outside-repo>/record.json. Set tested_commit and the observed archive hash/URLs/preparer only; do not fabricate installed_by or acceptance passes.
Run python scripts/check_readiness.py --release --evidence <outside-repo>/record.json --archive <downloaded.zip>. Expected NOT READY for incomplete evidence, with no ZIP mismatch errors.

Existing scripts/check_readiness.py archive_errors(zip_path, tracked, blob_reader) performs the inventory/SHA-256 comparisons; tracked = git ls-tree -r --name-only <SHA>, blob_reader = git show <SHA>:<path>.

Before extraction inspect all ZIP entries: safe_path; casefold-unique names; no encrypted or symlink entries; ZipFile.testzip() returns None. Scan every file with the existing verify_repo.py credential signatures and prohibited-path categories recorded above; never print matched values.

Decode each assets/samples WAV with wave.readframes(nframes), checking full expected PCM byte count; load each corresponding PNG with Pillow.Image.load(); compare media hashes with its .candidate.json. Vocal .lyrics.txt UTF-8 text must equal manifest lyrics.
Extract under an external scratch directory only after the path checks. Compare all 169 extracted source files byte-for-byte with archive members. No Git metadata is present.

Remove the eight JUKEBOX_* service values from the child environment, confirm no .env in extraction, and run python scripts/dev.py --port 8032. GET health, root, status, session and all six sample media URLs; compare media bytes and UTF-8 lyrics to the archive/manifest. GET session again: zero jobs. Stop only that process tree and verify the port closes.
